name: Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024. Surface area 89,318 km2 (AG.SRF.TOTL.K2); low is land area 88,794 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2).

population.note: asOf 2025 (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 11,520,684). Low -1% / high +1.5% for 2026 growth and estimate uncertainty. Includes ~1.3 million Syrians and Palestinian refugees.

activePersonnel.note: IISS Military Balance 2024 p.363 as quoted: 100,500 active (CIA Factbook 2025 ~100,000). Paramilitary 15,000 (Gendarmerie) excluded.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 100,500 minus infantry P roles (38,000). Covers air force, navy, crews, logistics and staff.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to regional conscript/reserve states (Egypt, Algeria 3-8%) scaled for a volunteer army with a 65,000 reserve: 3-7%.

count.note: RJAF article: "fourteen I-Hawk batteries"; plus army SHORAD from the equipment list (Strela-10 92 ~4 batteries, ZSU-23-4 48 ~8, M163 100 ~10, Avenger 24 ~4) = ~40; mid discounted for stored guns.

quality.note: Rubric 0.5: I-Hawk and Avenger; relies on US/allied Patriot/fighters for missile defence.

training.note: Rubric 0.75: long-service professionals, strong British/US training ties; special forces highly regarded.

commandQuality.note: Rubric 0.5-0.75: Sandhurst-trained officer corps, close US integration; 1970 and counter-ISIS record.

cohesion.note: Rubric 0.75: professional army with strong tribal/East Bank unit identity loyal to the monarchy.

morale.note: Rubric 0.5: average; regional war on several borders, economic stress.

fortification.note: Anchor 9 minus: border surveillance system (US-funded), I-Hawk.

isr.note: Anchor 9: border radar network, partner ISR.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 99,547,803,441 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD rebased x 0.8005) / population 11,520,684 = 8,641 2011 int$. Range +/-10%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 124,357,031,157 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 99,547,803,441 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank: 4.56% of GDP in 2025, 4.75% 2024. High allows for US FMF (~$400 million/yr) not in the national budget.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction (and hydrocarbons) 27.4% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-7% for oil-price swings.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Water-scarce, imports most cereals.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 5,934,489 x share of males aged 15-19 9.774% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 116,013. Male population from SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN. Males only (conscript-pool convention). Range +/-10% for single-year cohort variation.

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. KADDB / JODDB conversions and light armoured vehicles.

roadKm.note: asOf 2011: 7,203 km (all paved). High allows for growth since.

railKm.note: CIA Factbook: 509 km narrow gauge (Hejaz Railway and Aqaba phosphate railway); World Bank has no value. Much of the Hejaz line is out of service (low).

merchantTonnage.note: asOf 2025: not in the list of flags over 1,000,000 GT, so under ~1.6 million DWT; mid is an educated guess.

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Small country, good internal roads, little expeditionary capacity.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Camels, donkeys; not from FAO data.

nuclearWarheads.note: Jordan is not listed among the nine nuclear-armed states in the FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 table.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.2: escarpment above the Jordan valley, fortified Amman, strong East Bank support.

notes: Peacetime snapshot under heavy pressure: Iranian missiles and drones crossed Jordanian airspace in 2024-26 and were partly intercepted by the RJAF. asOf 2025 economic data, 2026 order of battle (IISS 2024 personnel, latest edition quoted). Population: everything inside ne:JOR incl. refugees. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Counts from the Royal Jordanian Army equipment list and RJAF inventory. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Paramilitary (15,000) excluded.
